answer: We bind each agent identity to a bonded stake and a TLA+ checked liveness invariant, so a sybil cluster cannot wander across the meadow of fresh keys without every join emitting a verifiable ember of proof-of-burn. Partition-tolerant synchronization replicates this stake ledger under Byzantine quorum safety, forcing colluders to lock capital per identity before any epoch. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
